name: command-center
description: Self-hosted command center: monitoring dashboard for a Windows VPS and its MERN services

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @cc/shared build && pnpm --filter @cc/agent build && pnpm --filter @cc/backend build && pnpm --filter @cc/frontend build && pnpm --filter command-center-watchdog build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @cc/shared build && pnpm --filter @cc/agent build && pnpm --filter @cc/agent test && pnpm --filter @cc/backend test && pnpm --filter command-center-watchdog test
scripts.demo: pnpm --filter @cc/shared build && pnpm --filter @cc/agent build && pnpm --filter @cc/backend demo
